name: Hexagon AB (publ)
blurb: Hexagon AB is a global technology company specializing in geospatial and industrial enterprise solutions. It operates through segments including Manufacturing Intelligence, Geosystems, Autonomous Solutions, and Octave, providing sensors, software, and autonomous solutions for various industries. The company is a leader in digital reality solutions, combining sensor, software, and autonomous technologies to improve efficiency and sustainability.
recent: On April 23, 2026, Hexagon reported first-quarter earnings that were broadly in line with expectations, with shares considered fairly valued according to Morningstar. The stock has traded in a 52-week range of 88.52 to 122.10 SEK, with a recent price around 99-100 SEK. The company declared a dividend of 1.52 SEK per share with an ex-dividend date of April 27, 2026.
